manager.description: Dynamic session orchestrator. Delegates to 7 specialized subagents via task tool.

manager-explore.description: Read-only codebase exploration: find files, search code, understand architecture.

manager-review.description: Read-only code review: bugs, security, performance, style.

manager-debug.description: Debugging session: trace bugs, analyze root causes, output fix plan.

manager-design.description: Architecture planning: design, trade-offs, API, class hierarchies.

manager-general.description: General-purpose coding: write code, refactor, fix bugs, any task.

manager-implement.description: Detailed implementation: write new features, create classes, build modules.

manager-test.description: Test generation: unit tests, edge cases, coverage.
